Contributing to WildObsR

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for helping improve WildObsR. This page explains how to report a problem, ask for a tutorial, and propose a change.

Report a problem or ask for a tutorial

Open an issue and pick a template:

  • Bug report, when a function does not do what its help page says. Include the shortest code that shows the problem. If you can, use example_datapackages(), so others can run it without an API key. Never paste your API key into an issue.
  • Lesson or tutorial request, when you want to run an analysis the articles do not cover yet.

Questions about a project’s data or metadata, or corrections to them, go to the WildObs team at data@wildobs.org.au, since the database is maintained separately from this package.

Propose a change

  1. Open an issue first for anything beyond a small fix, so we can agree on the approach.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  3. Make the change, with tests in tests/testthat/ for any new behaviour.
  4. Run devtools::document(), devtools::test() and devtools::check(). A pull request should leave the check with no errors and no warnings.
  5. Add a line to NEWS.md under the development version, saying what changed for users.
  6. Open a pull request that describes what the change does and why.

Tests that query the live WildObs database run only when a WILDOBSR_API_KEY is set, and never in CI. Everything else runs offline, against the bundled example data and a recorded slice of the public API (tests/testthat/fixtures/).

Code conventions

  • Use the native pipe |> and <- for assignment.
  • Build file paths with here::here().
  • Comment generously and in plain English: say what each step does to the data and why, not what the R syntax is. Put a short comment above each step of a pipe chain.
  • Write error messages that say what went wrong and what to do about it.
  • Document every exported function with roxygen2, including @examples that run, preferably on example_datapackages().

Vignettes

Vignettes that query WildObs are written as vignettes/<name>.Rmd.orig and knitted with Rscript vignettes/precompute.R <name>, using your own API key. Commit both the .Rmd.orig and the knitted .Rmd. Results must come only from the public API.

Code of conduct

Be respectful and constructive. We aim for a welcoming community of ecologists and developers at every level of experience.
